themes.title: Fuel Policy Rollbacks & Price Backlash
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures in both the United States and Norway are actively capitalizing on consumer frustration over high energy and pump prices. In the US, the Trump administration is pushing deregulation by rolling back federal fuel efficiency standards, while in Norway, the Progress Party (FrP) is demanding immediate fuel tax cuts as petrol prices hit historic highs.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration scales back CAFE fuel economy standards while facing criticism over sustained high energy prices.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP leader Sylvi Listhaug sharply criticizes political rivals and demands fuel tax reductions as prices top 31 kroner per liter.
